sources.title: Ravens sign linebacker Jamon Johnson
sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens made a mid-training camp addition on Friday afternoon, signing linebacker Jamon Johnson to their roster — as first reported by The Athletic’s Jeff Zrebiec. The Ravens had worked out three total linebackers during the week before adding Johnson. Johnson, 24, is a Maryland native who attended high school in Baltimore. He appeared […]
